Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE complete original TRAQUEUSE female cyberpunk sniper/ninja player sprite. Native64 game asset: the whole adult figure will be56 pixels high inside a64×64 cell. Genuine transparent background with empty margins. No ground, cast shadow, glow halo, text, logo, weapon, rifle, blade, holster, drone or prop.
Identity: an athletic adult WOMAN, natural human proportions and practical fully covered tactical clothing, compact waist and agile stable legs. Clearly human, not a robot; warm medium-light skin on any uncovered face/arm. Dark brown hair tied in one SMALL low knot when uncovered, no long hair plume. A small integrated blue optic at viewer-left temple, one cybernetic forearm/hand on viewer RIGHT and one cybernetic lower leg on viewer LEFT. These localized augmentations remain consistent as armor increasingly covers them. Two arms, two empty hands slightly away from torso, two separate feet, no extra limb. Do not sexualize the armor: no cleavage, exposed abdomen, high heels, decorative breasts or exaggerated hourglass.
Original class identity: covert sharpshooter / cybernetic ninja, low close-fitting collar, fitted fabric underlayer, a slightly asymmetrical short cross-body protective wrap and compact sloping armor pieces. Quiet diagonal torso lines and agile human cloth silhouette. No robe, long coat, cape, capelet, tabard, skirt, long scarf tail or hanging panels. No oversized brawler shoulder blocks or large barrel chest like Bastion; no full pale robotic chassis like Technomancien. Armor must look mobile, fitted, and class-specific even in the heavy tiers.
Palette: deep desaturated blue-slate/navy tactical fabric with broad lighter blue-grey lit folds, matte medium/light SMOKY BLUE-GREY protective shells, restrained pale cool-grey lit planes. Broad quiet color masses. Warm skin and a compact pale icy-blue visor/optic separate the head from the torso. The head MUST be as readable as armor at native64, never a nearly-black featureless blob. No neon piping, bright dots all over, bright orange/copper chest or ivory robot armor.
Rendering: coherent polished small game sprite, almost frontal balanced stance with a subtle elevated classic roguelike view, compact human head about8–9 native pixels tall WITH headgear, short neck nested into shoulders. Economy of large matte value planes,2–3 shades per material, simple upper-left light, restrained silhouette edging. No photoreal textures, gritty noise, micro-scratches, rivets, tiny pouches, strings, many little straps, vent grids or scattered highlights. One or two clear big folds per fabric area. Clear negative spaces at arms, hips and feet. Do not enlarge the head to show its details.
Draw the ENTIRE outfit and head together: gloves, sleeves/arms, torso, trousers, knees and boots all adapt to the specified protection rank. Head protection also changes across ranks, from uncovered to a compact fully closed sniper helmet. Keep the same adult scale and compact head; no tall crowns, horns, crests or giant visor dome.

Agile cloth tactical trousers with only one or two modest knee reinforcements, narrow practical ankle boots; cyborg lower leg on viewer-left partly exposed. Very little hard body coverage. HEAD: uncovered normal human female face and small tied dark hair, pale temple optic frame and one blue lens. The light skin face must form a readable warm mass at native64. No hood or helmet at this stage. About24–25 native pixels wide.
Input reference: this NEW complete stage03 Traqueuse locks her female human identity, same localized augmentations, cool blue-slate palette, short-neck proportions and economical rendering. It is NOT a requirement to keep the stage03 armor coverage or headgear. Redesign outfit AND head protection for the specified stage, visibly different from the reference. Keep adult human anatomy and normal head size, never enlarge the helmet. Keep empty hands and a compact upright stance.
